name: blocklist.de
tier_rationale: Long-running community project with an identifiable operator and public documentation (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Fail2ban-style reports of the last 48 h: real attacks, but noisy (shared and dynamic addresses).

all.title: blocklist.de attack IPs (all.txt, last 48 h)

terms.quote: Noncommercial, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: blocklist.de, CINS, ET compromised IPs, GreenSnow and DataPlane (A1 BR16), VoIPBL, and the FireHOL level1 aggregate (it embeds noncommercial upstreams such as DShield).

all.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 2); research C0348 terms 'Free for non-commercial use; attribute source' (verified_live 200, ETag + If-Modified-Since). LOW fidelity (P149 cond 6). Used by ip_blocklists.
all.licensed_alternative: The open feeds of ip_blocklists (Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP, abuse.ch Feodo Tracker and SSLBL, IPsum, Binary Defense) keep running; a licence_allow entry recording the operator's written permission enables this feed.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P149). Downloaded whole by the dataset manager (conditional GET, validation) and matched locally: no value is ever sent. Never redistributed outside the team (P149 cond 2).
